name: Bane
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Your presence becomes fearful to your foes. Roll Awe vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, the creature takes -1d to all attack rolls and contests.

Describe how you instill fear.
successes:
✨: You may target one additional creature within medium range.

🌞: On each win, the creature instead takes -2d to all attack rolls and contests. On each loss, the creature checks a Condition.
